prompts.default: Design a modern, accessible component for a stickman animation website using Tailwind CSS. Focus on smooth animations, clean typography, and engaging user interactions.
prompts.animation: Create an animated component that showcases stickman animations with smooth transitions, hover effects, and engaging micro-interactions.
prompts.landing: Design a landing page section that highlights animation services with modern UI patterns, clear CTAs, and visual hierarchy.
prompts.portfolio: Create a portfolio showcase component with grid layouts, filtering, and smooth animations for displaying animation work.
